title: EnginEx Template Grammar
notes: Expression semantics are defined by the restricted interpreter; unsupported JavaScript syntax is rejected.
Ordinary interpolation is HTML-escaped. Triple-brace interpolation requires engine-branded trusted HTML.
Legacy <?njs ?> blocks are rejected by safe-mode validation.

productions.template: (text | escapedInterpolation | rawInterpolation | comment | block | partial | legacyBlock)*
productions.block: ifBlock | unlessBlock | eachBlock | withBlock | extendsBlock | namedBlock
productions.restrictedExpression: literal | identifier | propertyAccess | arrayLiteral | objectLiteral | unaryExpression | binaryExpression | conditionalExpression | helperCall | '(' restrictedExpression ')'
productions.literal: string | finiteNumber | true | false | null | undefined

securityConstraints.functionCalls: Only direct calls to registered helpers are permitted; methods on data objects cannot be invoked.
securityConstraints.propertyAccess: Own data properties only; prototype-sensitive names blocked.
securityConstraints.rawInterpolation: Requires safeHtml() or a trusted safe helper. htmlAttr(value) is intended only for quoted attribute values; safeUrl(value) is a URL scheme policy helper and should be used with normal escaped interpolation.
securityConstraints.pathResolution: Partial/layout paths must remain within the configured template root by default.
securityConstraints.untrustedTemplateAuthors: Do not treat arbitrary static HTML as safe; preview and publication permissions are separate.
